name: d2b VS DEARDROPS -Cross the Future-
source:
A collaboration fandisk celebrating the 5th anniversary of OVERDRIVE, featuring a crossover between Kira☆Kira and DEARDROPS. Riho watches Kirari and Shouichi’s overseas performance on TV and sees that Shouichi is enjoying it more than before. She wonders if she would be able to beat Kirari. At that moment, she never thought that she would have a chance to do just that. 

[From Micchi's [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]blog[/url]]
translation:
OVERDRIVE成立5周年纪念合作FD，让《Kira☆Kira》与《DEARDROPS》两部作品的角色跨界共演。芳谷律穗在电视上观看椎野绮罗里与菅沼翔一的海外演出，发现翔一比以前更加享受舞台。她不禁思考，自己是否能够战胜绮罗里。那一刻，她怎么也不会想到，真正一较高下的机会很快便会到来。

[译自Micchi的[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/11/01/november-2011-eroge-releases/]博客[/url]]
